description: This file defines a PHP class 'diff' that implements a file diff algorithm, including methods for computing differences, formatting code, and rendering inline diffs with HTML.

classes.name: diff
classes.description: A PHP class providing file diff functionality, including methods for computing differences, formatting code snippets, and rendering inline HTML diffs.

methods.name: doDiff
methods.description: Computes the difference between two arrays or files, returning a diff structure.

methods.name: diffWrap
methods.description: Wraps the doDiff method to identify changed lines.

methods.name: formatcode
methods.description: Formats code snippets into HTML with entities and non-breaking spaces.

methods.name: showline
methods.description: Determines if a line should be shown based on line padding and changes.

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Generates an HTML table showing inline differences between two code snippets.
